angles.name: Tactics
angles.description: How the side plays: shape, pressing, build-up and what changed on the pitch, shown with the match stats (xG, shots, possession, field tilt), not adjectives.

angles.name: Form vs numbers
angles.description: The run of results against the underlying numbers: is the form real, lucky, or about to turn?

angles.name: Manager
angles.description: The manager's decisions and the pressure on them: selections, substitutions, tenure, and what the results and the board say.

angles.name: Squad and injuries
angles.description: Who is available, who is overplayed, and how absences or rotation have changed the side.

angles.name: Money and transfers
angles.description: Spending, wages, sales and the business model behind the squad. Fees only as reported by the clubs or two independent outlets.

angles.name: Breakout player
angles.description: One player whose rise or fall explains the team right now, told in numbers.

angles.name: Rivalry and history
angles.description: The fixture or rival that defines this side, and what the record between them actually says.

angles.name: Fans and the city
angles.description: The supporters, the ground and the place: attendances, ticket prices, ownership, protest and identity.

angles.name: Stakes
angles.description: What is on the line in the table or the draw: the title, qualification, relegation, prize money, and the paths still open.

angles.name: Discipline and officiating
angles.description: Cards, penalties, VAR calls and suspensions: what the record shows, not the grievances.
